knownConfigSurfaces: agents/*.toml: name, description, developer_instructions, model, model_reasoning_effort, sandbox_mode
rules/darkroom.rules: prefix_rule(pattern, decision, justification, match, not_match)
config.toml [sandbox_workspace_write] network_access (documented for the reverse bridge)
plugin: plugin.json (Agent Plugins root manifest: $schema, name, version, description, author, homepage, repository, license, keywords, extensions.com.openai.interface)
plugin: hooks/hooks.json (template shared with the Claude plugin; Codex ignores hooks in a root-manifest plugin)
notes: codexVersion is the latest stable @openai/codex npm version this repo was last triaged against. bun run upstream:scan diffs it against the live npm version; a Codex stable release is tagged rust-v<X> on github.com/openai/codex and its notes come from `gh release view rust-v<X> -R openai/codex --json body`. Alpha and Python SDK tags are not tracked.

knownConfigSurfaces is reference-only. cc-settings has no zod schema for config.toml, agents/*.toml, or .rules files, so the scanner cannot diff this list against code; it exists so /cc sync knows which Codex surfaces to cross-reference when a release note names one. Update it by hand when the installer starts writing or reading a new Codex surface.
